writeFileSync(fakeCodex, `#!/bin/sh
set -eu
cat > "${root}/delivered-$PROOF_OR_STOP_AGENT.txt"
case "$(cat "${root}/delivered-$PROOF_OR_STOP_AGENT.txt")" in *"Review the initial background + checklist"*|*"Review whether the INIT"*) ;; *) exit 41;; esac
printf '%s' "$LATTICE_MANAGED_INIT_INVOCATION" > "${root}/attestation-$PROOF_OR_STOP_AGENT.json"
: > "${root}/ready-$PROOF_OR_STOP_AGENT"
i=0
while [ ! -f "${root}/ready-proof-or-stop-review-story-init" ] || [ ! -f "${root}/ready-proof-or-stop-product-reviewer" ]; do
  i=$((i+1))
  if [ "$i" -gt 500 ]; then echo 'barrier timeout: peer reviewer never became ready' >&2; exit 42; fi
  sleep 0.02
done
case "$PROOF_OR_STOP_AGENT" in
  proof-or-stop-review-story-init) peer=proof-or-stop-product-reviewer ;;
  *) peer=proof-or-stop-review-story-init ;;
esac
for mode in tamper-story tamper-role tamper-signature missing-signature malformed-null; do
  if "${process.execPath}" "${unifiedExecShim}" "$mode" "${cli}" init_check_set "{\"storyId\":\"${storyId}\",\"issues\":[],\"agentId\":\"$PROOF_OR_STOP_AGENT\"}"; then exit 43; fi
done
if LATTICE_MANAGED_INIT_INVOCATION="$(cat "${root}/attestation-$peer.json")" "${process.execPath}" "${unifiedExecShim}" normal "${cli}" init_check_set "{\"storyId\":\"${storyId}\",\"issues\":[],\"agentId\":\"$PROOF_OR_STOP_AGENT\"}"; then exit 44; fi
if [ "$PROOF_OR_STOP_AGENT" = proof-or-stop-review-story-init ]; then
  env -u LATTICE_MANAGED_INIT_INVOCATION "${process.execPath}" "${cli}" init_check_set "{\"storyId\":\"${storyId}\",\"issues\":[],\"agentId\":\"$PROOF_OR_STOP_AGENT\"}"
else
  "${process.execPath}" "${unifiedExecShim}" normal "${cli}" init_check_set "{\"storyId\":\"${storyId}\",\"issues\":[],\"agentId\":\"$PROOF_OR_STOP_AGENT\"}"
  if "${process.execPath}" "${unifiedExecShim}" normal "${cli}" init_check_set "{\"storyId\":\"${storyId}\",\"issues\":[],\"agentId\":\"$PROOF_OR_STOP_AGENT\"}"; then exit 45; fi
fi
printf '%s\n' '{"type":"turn.completed","usage":{}}'
`);
